activity_summary: At the deposing, nobody moved. Then John asked, twice in the same breath, where it was written that you could play this king this week. James named the gallows at the Mayor's door. George said send the book to the Master whole, and the cutting his. The room agreed. Kemp, in from the doors and the news, heard the end and asked where he came in. You told him he was late, and that it was already done. You did not promise him a part today. Dick took the forty leaves home under his arm. Nothing of the king is to be billed this week. No one is carrying a book to the Master tonight.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the end, agreed the book goes whole, and answered Kemp without a promise.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Would have played the king as read, and took the leaves home under his arm.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Asked where this week was written down as allowed, and sent the house home without a second round of news.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Refused a crown taken off on his stage, and kept the afternoon struck.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Refused a tiring-house mend, and wanted the gate to see a quiet house.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Moved that the Master do the cutting, and that no one carry the book tonight.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Came from the news at the doors, heard the end, and asked where he entered.

facets.activity: Agreed to send the king whole, and let the leaves go

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: I don't— I don't say we can't. Show me where it's written that we can, this week

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: They set a gallows at the Mayor's door on Friday, and you'd put a king down on my stage

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: Send it to the Master whole, and let the cutting be his and not ours

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: And where do I come in

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Late, Will. You've done it already;
